policy_presence.summary: Official generative AI guidance and scope boundaries for KIT, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology are retained in local candidate evidence pending independent presentation review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Informatics requires identification of AI use in assessed work, with correction/translation exceptions needing preservation.

coursework.summary: Informatics permits uses consistent with course learning goals, subject to instructor variations.

exams.summary: Examination-context KI-Toolbox use needs express approval by the responsible examination officials.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Personal data may be processed only with KIT-hosted local models; external Azure and Google models are excluded.

academic_integrity.summary: An unapproved aid may trigger the applicable programme examination provisions; no blanket AI penalty is established.

approved_tools.summary: The Toolbox includes local and externally delivered models. Access is not permission for examinations.

named_ai_services.summary: Named AI services for KIT, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology are retained as discovery records pending independent presentation review; service availability does not grant assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: The ZML generator is optional; faculty and instructors set binding course rules.

research_guidance.summary: KIT-wide guidelines defer to existing research and publisher rules; thesis-specific current policies need checking.

security_procurement.summary: SCC prohibits very-high-risk and export-controlled inputs; procurement workflow beyond service terms needs verification.
